baselines.IWM: buy at the first locked session open, whole shares, Futubull fee, mark at each close
baselines.RANDOM4: 1000 draws, random.Random(20260813 + draw), 4 names from that day's frozen universe, long, hold 1, time exit at the next session open. A baseline, not the keep-held book.

hard_red_rule: When the frozen send file carries s and s is at or below hard_red_max, new buys sit. A missing s does not sit. List-drop sells still happen. A kept lot is not liquidated.
min_hold: recipe hold in locked sessions; the entry session counts as zero
renewal: A held name that is still selected that morning stays. The book records no sell and no buy for that name and charges no fee.
v4_hook: hooks/v4_winners.json may only gain winners. first_session is the first locked session after the fingerprint commit. Earlier sessions stay as written.
